stages.montessori_scope: Practical life: carry tray, spoon transfer, tidy up; sensorial: big/small, colors, texture; language: object naming and rhymes; culture: family, plants, animals.
stages.math_scope: Match sets 1–3; compare more/less with objects; sort by one property.
stages.robotics_scope: Build towers; predict rolling/falling; sequence first/next; no screens required.
stages.islam_scope: Bismillah before eating, alhamdulillah for gratitude, greetings, kindness, short recitation exposure.
stages.assessment: Adult observes pointing, matching and independent attempts; no scored exams.

stages.montessori_scope: Pouring, dressing frames, sound discrimination, prewriting, three-period lessons.
stages.math_scope: Count and match up to 10; AB patterns; basic 2D shapes; compare lengths.
stages.robotics_scope: Unplugged arrows, simple paths, balance and ramps.
stages.islam_scope: Cleanliness, sharing, family adab, listening to short stories, memorization by choice.

stages.montessori_scope: Phoneme-to-letter connections, movable letters, quantities/symbols, continents and life cycles.
stages.math_scope: Compose/decompose within 10; number bonds; addition/subtraction with counters.
stages.robotics_scope: Sequence and debug simple robot-like actions; design-build-test.
stages.islam_scope: Intro to five pillars, wudu demonstration, selected short surahs and duas.

stages.montessori_scope: Reading simple words, place-value bead equivalents, maps, botany, time routines.
stages.math_scope: Bonds to 20; ten-frames; tens and ones; pictorial word problems.
stages.robotics_scope: Loops as repeated actions, simple mechanical linkages, supervised programmable toys.
stages.islam_scope: Prayer movements and meaning, prophetic stories, compassion and responsibility.
stages.assessment: Portfolio and readiness observation; no forced acceleration.

stages.montessori_scope: Reading fluency, writing, decimal system, science observation, geography.
stages.math_scope: Numbers to 100; addition/subtraction to 20 then 100; lengths, time, money, shapes; CPA.
stages.robotics_scope: Directional commands, debug path, simple sensors and engineering notebooks.
stages.islam_scope: Foundational creed with age-appropriate language, daily duas, wudu, salah, short surahs, adab.
stages.assessment: Short independent practice plus manipulatives; review after 1/7/30 days.

stages.montessori_scope: Grammar, timelines, place-value operations, ecology and research.
stages.math_scope: Numbers to 1,000; regrouping; multiplication as equal groups; division sharing; simple fractions.
stages.robotics_scope: Block coding sequences, loops, gears and levers, test criteria.
stages.islam_scope: Prayer consistency without coercion, seerah chronology, truthful speech, basic aqidah terms.
stages.assessment: Explain with objects, pictures and words.

stages.montessori_scope: Cosmic education, ecology, fractions, independent reading and reports.
stages.math_scope: Times tables, division, fractions, 2-step bar models, perimeter and area.
stages.robotics_scope: If/then, simple sensors, prototypes, error logs.
stages.islam_scope: Distinguish Creator and creation in approved language; worship, ethics, Qur’an recitation.

stages.montessori_scope: History/geography research, experiments, writing and geometry.
stages.math_scope: Multi-digit operations, equivalent fractions, decimals, measurement conversions, area.
stages.robotics_scope: Low-voltage circuits, motor control, variables and data collection.
stages.islam_scope: Aqidah with carefully sourced texts, fiqh practice, civic manners and charity.

stages.montessori_scope: Scientific method, biology, world history, research presentations.
stages.math_scope: Fractions/decimals, percentage, ratio foundations, volume and multi-step problems.
stages.robotics_scope: Microcontrollers, loops, conditionals, debugging and data ethics.
stages.islam_scope: Intro to rational/textual reasoning in creed with scholar review, worship and service.

stages.montessori_scope: Interdisciplinary capstones, advanced grammar, civic responsibility, ecology.
stages.math_scope: Ratios, percentages, algebraic patterns, geometry and data literacy.
stages.robotics_scope: Robotics capstone with sensors, testing, documentation and safety review.
stages.islam_scope: Age-appropriate Ash’ari/Maturidi vocabulary, verified source reading, jurisprudential respect and service.
